metadata.name: Claude-chan: Risk Control
metadata.description: An AI-personification parody with 11 model families, 22 normal and tainted forms, and distinct resource mechanics. Claude uses account limits and appeals; DeepSeek uses Rice First and Peak / Valley without proxy risk. Character designs credited to ZipZipPipe and the artists listed in resources/ART_LICENSE.md; non-commercial fan work. Not affiliated with the model providers. Development build; gameplay and art acceptance remain in progress.
